description: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of a protein in the cytoplasm. This is a ribosome-mediated process in which the information in messenger RNA (mRNA) is used to specify the sequence of amino acids in the protein. [GOC:hjd]
label: CYTOPLASMIC TRANSLATION *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a response to stress. Response to stress is a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a disturbance in organismal or cellular homeostasis, usually, but not necessarily, exogenous (e.g. temperature, humidity, ionizing radiation). [GOC:dhl]
label: REGULATION OF RESPONSE TO STRESS *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a defense response. [GOC:mah]
label: REGULATION OF DEFENSE RESPONSE *

description: Any process that modulates the frequency, rate or extent of a response to an external stimulus. [GOC:mah]
label: REGULATION OF RESPONSE TO EXTERNAL STIMULUS *

description: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell or an organism (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of a stimulus indicating damage to the organism. [GOC:go_curators]
label: RESPONSE TO WOUNDING *

description: Any process that stops, prevents, or reduces the frequency, rate or extent of a response to an external stimulus. [GOC:mah]
label: NEGATIVE REGULATION OF RESPONSE TO EXTERNAL STIMULUS *

description: The immediate defensive reaction (by vertebrate tissue) to infection or injury caused by chemical or physical agents. The process is characterized by local vasodilation, extravasation of plasma into intercellular spaces and accumulation of white blood cells and macrophages. [GO_REF:0000022, ISBN:0198506732]
label: INFLAMMATORY RESPONSE *

description: The directed movement of some substance from outside of a cell, across the plasma membrane and into the cytosol. [GOC:dos]
label: IMPORT ACROSS PLASMA MEMBRANE *

description: Any process that activates or increases the frequency, rate, or extent of interleukin-8 production. [GOC:mah]
label: POSITIVE REGULATION OF INTERLEUKIN 8 PRODUCTION *
